About Spyke Games

We are a leading mobile gaming company founded by gaming veterans who have built and scaled massive gaming businesses for the past decade.

We want to build the next generation of mobile game franchises to be played by millions of people around the globe for years. We are bringing together the smartest, the most talented and ‘fun to work with’ group of people united around this single mission. Fostered with team spirit and collaboration, we strive to create a passionate, energetic and eager to learn “geek” culture focused on games.

We’re looking for a talented QA Specialist to help us continue building world-class games and forever franchises. In this role, you will be working in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment with some of the most creative minds in the industry. You will act as the focal point in product development. As a QA Specialist you will identify risks to the quality of testing in the product, process.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
• Audit testing approaches, provide detailed recommendations for improvement, and address tactical gaps.
• Identify risks to the quality of testing in the product, process, and people and then develop and execute on solving those challenges through internal and external resources.
• Working with product team to develop test scenarios and cases.

JOB REQUIREMENTS
• Experience as a QA Specialist in mobile gaming industry
• Solid understanding of test methodologies and iterative development
• Proven experience of leading and managing multiple teams such as product, art and development
• Strong collaboration skills and works well with others
• Ability to communicate effectively, plan and organize work activities, analyze the information, and manage work time efficiently.
We respect your privacy and will treat your data confidential as part of the recruitment process. If you’d like more details, please read our Statement of Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK)
